Name: Covehn's Cozy Farmhouse
Author: covehn
Description:
Presenting a smaller farmhouse for those who want a cozier playthrough.

Renovations make the space slightly larger but still keep the tighter layout. [b]Bedroom Wall and Dining Room Wall can't be removed, purchasing these renovations will make no changes.[/b]


All assets used are vanilla, so there shouldn't be any compatibility issues with recolor mods.
